items.title: Create the English execution-plan doc at the canonical decisions path in house format (Story header, plan-only scope note, Problem/Principles/Architecture/Roadmap sections)
items.context: Match the format of lattice-llm-usage-ledger-execution-plan.md; freeform English markdown; plan only, no source code.
items.userSees: File docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md exists; opens with a Story: B-xxxx header and a scope note stating it is a future-execution plan only.

happy.desc: File exists at docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md -> fs.existsSync returns true; WHY: canonical path is the only deliverable
First line of the doc is a markdown H1 title containing Experience Layer -> grep finds # ...Experience Layer...; WHY: house format requires title heading
Doc contains a Story: B-1480 header line (blockquote or heading) -> grep finds Story: B-1480; WHY: house format requires Story reference
Doc contains a scope note stating plan-only / no source code -> grep finds plan-only or future-execution-plan-only language; WHY: prevents misreading as implemented feature
Doc contains Problem Statement, Principles, Architecture, and Roadmap section headers -> grep finds all four H2/H3 headers; WHY: house format section coverage

edge.desc: Doc uses correct markdown heading levels (H1 for title, H2 for major sections) and no broken heading syntax -> regex scan for orphaned # or missing space after # finds none; WHY: rendering correctness
Doc is non-trivial length (at least 100 lines) -> wc -l returns >= 100; WHY: an execution plan this complex cannot be shorter than 100 lines without being incomplete

adversarial.desc: Doc path is exactly docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md with no typo or variant path -> only one file matching *experience-layer*execution-plan* exists in the repo; WHY: prevents near-miss file placement
No duplicate or stale copy of the doc exists elsewhere in the repo -> find . -name *experience-layer*execution-plan*.md returns exactly one result; WHY: prevents orphaned drafts

items.title: Record the grounded module decomposition and the reuse-not-rebuild and cut-FTS decisions
items.context: 4 core + 2 handler modules under packages/main with one-way inward coupling (usage-ledger style); reuse dev-memory capture, decision-doc-promotion digest pattern, activity-log appender; cut full-text search for v1.
items.userSees: The doc contains a module-decomposition section listing the new core/ and handlers/ modules, a reuse section naming dev-memory.ts / decision-doc-promotion.ts / activity-log.ts, and an explicit cut-FTS statement.

items.title: Document the three determinism guardrails and the back-compat rules
items.context: Guardrails: audit-only finding fields excluded from gates; finding-signals read via stable finding accessor (store.readFindings) not raw findings.json; hints excluded from reviewer promptHash domain. Back-compat: dismissReasonType optional; flat underscore command names.
items.userSees: The doc has a determinism-guardrails section enumerating all three guardrails and a back-compat note (optional dismissReasonType, flat underscore commands).

items.title: Document the phased roadmap with first story = verifiable finding-signals slice, and include accurate code anchors
items.context: Phased rollout (Phase 1a first, then 1b/1.5/2/3/4); first story is the finding-signals vertical slice proven by an unchanged currentMaterialHash() test; code anchors are real file paths.
items.userSees: The doc has a roadmap section naming Phase 1a as the first story and an appendix of real code anchors; no Co-Authored-By trailer anywhere.
